text:
alex: Heads up — canary for release 2026.3.9 (service: embeddings-svc) tripped the SBOM vuln gate (transitive package flagged, CVSS 7.2). Deploy-bot posted the alert.
deploy-bot: [auto] Release 2026.3.9 — canary failed security gate: SBOM_TRANSITIVE_VULN. Pinned digest mismatch: sha256:abc123 -> flagged package lib-embed/2.4.1 (transitive). Suggested actions: hold rollout, pin to previous digest, or rollback. Please ack and @security.
maria: what's the practical impact? is the vuln reachable in the runtime path or just build tooling?
sara-security: quick triage: the vulnerable component is pulled in by a build-time utility we use for generation, not loaded by the embeddings runtime. Exploit surface looks low. That said, scanner severity is high so policy requires either a rollback or an approved exception with remediation within 48h.
jamal: change window ends in ~2h. Ops prefers not to rollback mid-window unless there's active exploitation or a runtime failure.
alex: Ops — can we hotpatch by rebuilding the image with a different transitive dep resolution (minor bump) and push a canary image without rolling back traffic? That avoids reverting feature changes.
ops-bot: Canary is at 12% traffic. Hotpatch workflow: build new image, run smoke, promote canary. Estimated ~25 minutes for build + smoke. No rollback needed if smoke passes. If promotion fails, we must rollback.
maria: QA note: we have one flaky test in integration but it's unrelated to embeddings. If we do hotpatch, we need a focused smoke on the canary path.
sara-security: I can provisionally approve a timeboxed exception if you satisfy these conditions: (A) release notes explicitly call out the vulnerability and mitigation, (B) create a remediation ticket with owner and SLA (<=48h), (C) enable extra monitoring for increased error/latency for 24h. Otherwise policy mandates rollback.
alex: I will open the ticket and update release notes. Jamal — can you hold the rollout and queue the hotpatch image? Suggested commands:
```
/deploybot hold 2723456789 --reason "sbom transitive vuln"
/deploybot build-and-release --service=embeddings-svc --tag=2026.3.9-hotfix1
```
deploy-bot: Commands queued: hold and build-and-release requested. Requires confirmations from @jamal and @sara-security to proceed with exception.
jamal: confirmed. I'm OK with hotpatch + exception under the listed conditions. :thumbsup:
sara-security: approved (timeboxed exception). Please reference ticket SEC-3421 in the release notes and assign owner.
alex: SEC-3421 created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-3421 — owner @maria, due in 36h. PR for release notes added: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/987 (short entry under 2026.3.9).
maria: smoke run on hotfix image is green. No regressions observed in the canary logs.
ops-bot: Hotpatch image promoted to canary and then to 50% traffic per policy. Monitoring hooks (error-rate, latency p95) enabled with alert threshold error-rate >1%.
alex: Thanks all — proceeding with promotion to full rollout in 30m unless alerts fire. I'll close thread when rollout completes.
release-manager: noted. Please add a brief follow-up if remediation slips, otherwise we'll consider this a compliant exception. Keep the post-release notes updated."
